thread_text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] P95 token latency > 1.2s for /v1/generate in us-west-2 — paging @oncall :rotating_light:
Tess: got it, I'm oncall. grabbing logs and tracing now. anyone oncall overlap?
Alex Chen: I'm nearby, can help with triage if you want me to take the page.
Tess: please — alex, can you grab the model pool metrics? I'll look at the routing layer and prefixes.
Alex Chen: looking. gpu-util on pool-dedicated-1 shows 87% sustained, but per-host queue length spiked for requests with long sequences. KV cache hit rate dropped to 42%.
Sami Torres: that sounds like batching/backpressure mismatch. any recent deploys to routing?
Tess: no deploys in the last hour. config changed: autoscaler policy reverted to default at 15:08 (see deploy bot).
incident-bot: deploy-bot: autoscaler-config revert merged by infra-ci at 1768503000 — link: https://ci/reverts/987
Kamal Patel: ok — autoscaler revert explains lower burst capacity. I'm going to manually scale Dedicated pool + increase max batch size limit to 64 to reduce token latency.
Tess: do it. Alex, can you enable KV prefix caching for that route (TTL 10m)? Put a short test load after.
Alex Chen: enabling KV prefix caching now. snippet: ```redis-cli HSET prefix_cache /v1/generate:prefix 1```
Tess: scaled pool up x2, adjusting routing weights to send overflow to regional-fallback (us-east-1) for 10m.
Sami Torres: rolling tests — p95 back to 580ms on partial test traffic. KV hit rose to 78%.
incident-bot: [RESOLVED] P95 token latency back under SLO at 1768504600 — automatically closed.
Tess: thanks team. quick customer-impact check: any errors returned?
Alex Chen: there were ~1200 requests that saw 500/503 for ~9m during the spike. Most were retries that succeeded afterwards. Top affected customers: acme-marketing, sendgrid-integration (non-prod), and 3 smaller PLG orgs.
Maria Lopez: I'll open a customer-impact thread and reach out to top 3. tagging success to coordinate comms.
Tess: next: post-incident review. can we schedule a 45m postmortem slot tomorrow? we should capture timeline + actions.
Sami Torres: makes sense. also want a follow-up action to prevent autoscaler reverts from going to prod without gating.
Kamal Patel: agree. adding items: 1) autoscaler revert gating 2) improve KV cache defaults 3) add fallback routing SLA alarms.
Tess: ok let's assign owners and use the postmortem template. can we have the postmortem-bot create the doc and calendar event? currently it's manual and takes time.
postmortem-bot: noop — I can create a template doc if given an incident id. Usage: `@postmortem-bot create INCIDENT_ID #channel --time "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM TZ"`
Tess: Maria, can you kick off the doc and schedule for tomorrow 14:00 PT?
Maria Lopez: scheduling now. `@postmortem-bot create 2026-03-15-ivl-1768504321 #eng-oncall --time "2026-03-16 14:00 PT"`
postmortem-bot: created draft: https://docs/reports/pm-2026-03-15-1768504321 — calendar invite sent to participants.
Kamal Patel: nice. couple of tooling asks while we're at it:
Kamal Patel: - can the bot auto-populate the timeline from alert logs? like ingest incident-bot events and pre-fill the timeline section.
Sami Torres: +1. also want action-item tracking inside the doc that syncs to the action dashboard so we don't lose followups.
Alex Chen: is there an existing action dashboard? we have a simple spreadsheet but it's not ideal.
Maria Lopez: product suggested a tracking dashboard (incidents -> action items) last quarter but it's low-priority. we can escalate.
Tess: here's a proposed quick plan: ACTION/short-term (owners):
- ACTION: Maria Lopez - create postmortem doc + invite (done)
- ACTION: Kamal Patel - implement autoscaler-gating policy proposal (owner: kamal)
- ACTION: Alex Chen - default KV cache TTL bump and monitor (owner: alex)
- ACTION: Sami Torres - add fallback routing alarm (owner: sami)
- ACTION: incident-bot + postmortem-bot - proposal: auto-timeline ingest + create doc template (owner: postmortem-bot)
Sami Torres: I can draft the alarm rule now and open a PR for the escalations page.
Kamal Patel: I'll sketch the gating policy as a short RFC and link it into the postmortem doc.
Alex Chen: I'll push TTL change to staging then prod canary tonight.
Maria Lopez: logging the actions in the action tracker sheet and I'll create cards in the action dashboard board (ticketing: PM-INC-462).
Tess: for tooling improvements, can we get postmortem-bot to do two things in future: 1) when an incident resolves it suggests a 1-click postmortem schedule with available windows based on participant calendars; 2) pre-fill timeline with incident-bot events + top N error samples.
postmortem-bot: noted. feature request logged: PMBOT-138 — ETA: triage next sprint. Suggestions: allow `--autofill timeline,errors` flag.
Alex Chen: tiny improvement: incident-bot could include a short structured payload at close with `incident_id`, `start_ts`, `end_ts`, `top_errors`, `affected_customers` so bots can ingest.
Sami Torres: agreed. that would make timeline auto-fill deterministic.
Maria Lopez: I'll add a follow-up item to coordinate with developer experience to wire up calendar availability for the 1-click scheduling.
Tess: cool. can we also add a postmortem template update: include a small "customer comms recommendation" section and a checklist for when to notify sales/support?
Maria Lopez: added to doc draft.
Kamal Patel: rough ETA for my gating RFC: i'll have a draft in 3 business days.
Alex Chen: TTL bump deployed to prod canary at 1768507000, monitoring for regressions.
Sami Torres: fallback alarm PR opened: https://git/repo/pulls/512
postmortem-bot: Updated PMBOT-138 with linked actions: PM-INC-462, PR-512.
Tess: great work. final ask: for any follow-up items, please add the label `postmortem-action` in the tracker so ops can pull weekly status.
Maria Lopez: will do. closing loop here — I'll post the finalized postmortem link in #incidents after the doc is ready.
Alex Chen: thanks team. learning: autoscaler config changes should not be auto-merged to prod without a canary gate.
Kamal Patel: +1.
Tess: logging handoff: I'm oncall for the next 30m, then Alex will take over at 17:30 PT.
Alex Chen: noted. I'll monitor the canary pass.
incident-bot: reminder: postmortem scheduled 2026-03-16 14:00 PT — calendar invites sent. React :thumbsup: to confirm attendance.
